newsitem.title: TOGO: Togo says three border security men shot dead.
newsitem.headline: Togo says three border security men shot dead.

text.p: Togo said on Tuesday unidentified gunmen killed three of its security men at their post on the border with Ghana, just outside the capital Lome.

"In the night of 14th October around 1930 (GMT) hours, unknown people opened fire on a security post on the western frontier of Lome, killing three personnel on the spot," an interior ministry statement said. The attackers fled.
Togo's border posts are normally manned by soldiers or paramilitary gendarmes.
The statement advised residents of the capital to remain calm and denied rumours that a night curfew had been clamped on the city after the incident.

Togo has previously charged that its opponents were staging raids from Ghana across the border which runs through Lome's western suburbs. Relations between the two neighbours were strained for years over such charges but have markedly improved in recent years.
Togo is only now recovering from two years of political violence marked by rampant armed attacks that marred the country's transition to multi-party democracy.
